summary: Pull requests stop committing packages/claude-envoy/dist and legion. build.ts gains --out <dir> (runnable copy outside the repo), --in-place, and refuses no mode. Tests build fresh. The required test job and the claude-envoy job build from source. A new workflow .github/workflows/claude-envoy-rebuild.yaml (push to main, hourly, dispatch, and pull_request on its own files) builds main's tip in a credential-free job and lands a changed build with release-push.sh push-built (deploy key), which pushes only onto the commit it built from and otherwise dispatches a fresh run. check-release-credentials.sh covers the workflow and push-built. Guides, scripts and docs/solutions notes follow.

decisions.decision: No programmatic gate on a pull request's diff
decisions.reason: Deployment instructions order instruction, cross-review, then a gate after measurement; the plan rewrites the instruction, names the reviewer's check, and removes the accidental in-place write (build.ts refuses no mode; --out refuses a directory inside the repository).

decisions.decision: The required test job builds the plugin
decisions.reason: The claude-envoy job is not required (ruleset 12331919); without this a source that does not build could merge and keep main's rebuild failing.

decisions.decision: Push only onto the built commit; when main moved, dispatch a fresh run
decisions.reason: Release bump commits carry GitHub's skip keyword and start no run; dispatching avoids classifying build inputs and never rebases stale bytes.

decisions.decision: Rebuild commit starts CI (no skip keyword)
decisions.reason: Main's lint then checks the committed bundle for private names; no release path matches the two directories.

decisions.decision: Stale copy noticed by every run's compare, a red hourly run when a repaired copy was stale over 30 minutes, the production check of each plugin-changing pull request, and INFRA-633
decisions.reason: Spec asks how a stale copy is noticed; a repair alone reports nothing.

decisions.decision: A claude-envoy changelog entry in main's current form
decisions.reason: Spec's changelog exclusion is the changelog mechanism (INFRA-629).

Verdict pending until such a merge.

findings.finding: Nothing stops a pull request from committing dist/ or legion/; jj snapshots the in-place build; a guard in the non-required claude-envoy job blocks nothing
findings.answer: No diff gate (deployment instruction order). Instruction rewritten with the reviewer's check; build.ts refuses no mode and --out refuses a directory inside the repository, so nothing a PR needs writes the tracked files; INFRA-588's measurement decides any later gate.

findings.finding: A build that breaks can still merge (claude-envoy job not required) and then main's rebuild keeps failing
findings.answer: The required test job builds the plugin with --out.

findings.finding: The draft repairs a stale copy but never reports one
findings.answer: Hourly run ends red when it repaired a copy stale over 30 minutes; each plugin-changing PR's production check names the rebuild run and runs check-dist; INFRA-633 reads the latest run.

findings.finding: Skip-keyword rebase condition too loose; this PR's own text must not carry a literal skip keyword
findings.answer: No rebase at all: push only onto the built commit, else dispatch a fresh run. The plan tells the implementer to keep the literal keyword out of the PR's title, body and commits.

findings.finding: One concurrency group for every ref lets a branch run cancel main's pending run
findings.answer: Group claude-envoy-rebuild-${{ github.ref }}; build runs only on main or a pull_request touching its own files; push job only on main, with the rule 6 always()/needs.build.result shape.

findings.finding: A partial or empty artifact could delete the plugin from main; upload-artifact drops hidden files
findings.answer: One tar artifact; push-built refuses links, '..', members outside dist/ and legion/, and a tar missing the four bundles, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, legion/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, or any file under legion/skills or legion/agents; it checks the commit changes only the two directories.

findings.finding: Acceptance 1's example pairs do not conflict with rebuilt files, and the criterion proves little
findings.answer: Measured; control pair is two sentences of one folded tool description in contracts/src/dispatch-tools.ts; recorded as a spec departure; the tester also checks the PR diff carries nothing under the two directories.

findings.finding: Acceptance 4 may have no commit to name after this PR's own merge
findings.answer: Read as the first merge whose fresh build differs from main's files; exact checks named; recorded as a spec departure; verdict pending until then.

findings.finding: Outcome's 'main still holds matching files' cannot hold at every commit
findings.answer: Lag of one workflow run stated in the guide and the plan's risks; recorded as a spec departure.

findings.finding: Rules naming exactly three release workflows need rewording
findings.answer: check-release-credentials.sh WORKFLOWS/PUSH_COMMANDS/header/messages and its fixture; root AGENTS.md release-credential convention names the new workflow while the version clause stays the release workflows'; 'Deploys come only from main' rewritten.

findings.finding: A whole-repository private-name scan in the build job is fragile, and --out paths would miss the vendored-nats exemption
findings.answer: Run from the repository root with targets packages/claude-envoy/dist packages/claude-envoy/legion in both the rebuild job and the claude-envoy job.

findings.finding: The --out copy's skill symlinks would break; the dev-marketplace staged copy and smoke-clear-rebind default also run a built plugin
findings.answer: --out dereferences skills/; README's staged-copy paragraph and smoke-clear-rebind.sh's default use --out.

findings.finding: Siblings edit the same files; changelog entry vs 'not in scope: changelogs'
findings.answer: Implementer reads INFRA-629's open PR before editing root AGENTS.md, release.yaml or check-release-credentials.sh; INFRA-632 starts after this merges; one claude-envoy changelog entry in main's current form.

findings.finding: INFRA-633's 'a search of the repository shows it' needs a defined search; build.ts and legion-plugin-fresh messages say 'commit the result'
findings.answer: Exact git grep command in plan task 8; both messages rewritten (the test is deleted).

findings.finding: Claims without a source: ruleset, deploy-key bypass, measurements, spec's line and input list
findings.answer: Ruleset read via gh api (quoted in plan facts); deploy-key bypass evidenced by bump commit 8e53cdf3 landing on main; measurements quoted in the plan; build inputs no longer needed by the push logic; guides list the full build inputs.

specDepartures.plan: The control pair is two edits to different sentences of one tool description in packages/contracts/src/dispatch-tools.ts (lines 353 and 356 at 4e350fdf); the spec's pairs prove only the no-conflict half.

acceptance: 1: control pair replaced by two sentences of one folded tool description; the spec's example pairs do not conflict even with rebuilt files

specDepartures.spec: Acceptance 4: the first merge to main that changes a plugin source is followed by the workflow's commit.
specDepartures.plan: The first merge whose fresh build differs from main's committed files is followed by the workflow's commit; a source change that leaves the bytes the same (this PR's own merge) is followed by a green run and no commit.
specDepartures.evidence: This PR changes build.ts, tests and guides, which the bundles and legion/ do not contain (build.ts:101-131, 192-226), so its merge rebuilds identical bytes.

acceptance: 4: trigger read as the first merge whose fresh build differs from main's files

specDepartures.spec: Outcome: main still holds built files that match its sources.
specDepartures.plan: Main's files match its sources one workflow run after each merge; between the merge and the rebuild commit (minutes) they are the previous build.
specDepartures.evidence: The Scope's after-merge rebuild cannot commit inside the merge itself; the build job checks out main's tip and the push lands only onto that commit.

summary: Outcome's matching holds one workflow run after each merge, a lag of minutes
